The '''University of Alderaan''' was a center of learning whose main campus was on the planet Alderaan. It was also known as '''Alderaan University''', '''Aldera University''',<ref name="First to Strike">{{DoD|The First to Strike}}</ref> and the '''University of Aldera'''.<ref name="Princess Leia Diaries">{{Tales|11|The Princess Leia Diaries}}</ref> Its approach to education was an emphasis on hands-on experience in a student's chosen field, which led to many satellite campuses off-world. The main campus was destroyed along with Alderaan in 0 BBY.

==Founding==
The University of Alderaan had a [[Medcenter/Legends|medical facility]] attached to the Aldera campus, off the central quadrangle. There was also a large fountain with an ice sculpture of a man and a woman holding hands and reaching upwards. The campus also had a [[Unidentified tavern (University of Alderaan)|tavern]] in a secluded courtyard.<ref name="The Paradise Snare">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref>

==Later History==
[[File:UniversityOfAlderaan-PLD.png|250px|thumb|Leia Organa and Winter attending the university]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the university's [[Provost/Legends|provost]] was [[Dalus Othona]] and its dean was [[Halcor Raystel]]; the latter was eventually removed after a three-month scandal when it became known that he was a [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] user and had offered class credits to two female students in exchange for sexual favors.<ref name="HoloNet News 47">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|life/13314_2.html|Dean of Aldera Suspended}}</ref> [[Grabda Weng]] was, during that time, a [[Professor/Legends|professor]] of socio-politics at the University.<ref name="HoloNet News 55">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|jediwatch/1359_1.html|Jedi Taskforce Dispatched to Reel in Thranta}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Students of Collus]] were active on-campus.<ref name="Dark Lord">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

The former captain of the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], [[Jeremoch Colton/Legends|Jeremoch Colton]], spent his retirement teaching at the institution.<ref name="Empire at War">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Winter Celchu|Winter]] attended classes in art and history there, beginning before Leia was seventeen.<ref name="Princess Leia Diaries" />

Like the rest of Alderaan, its main building was destroyed by the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
